findings.risk: The extra close resolution is not one of the four explicit D4 resolution actions and closes with effect none. Existing remaining escrow may require separate reconciliation; this does not prove money loss or permission bypass.
findings.nextStep: DEC12/16 explicit residual-escrow policy and bounded tests before any close/financial change; preserve current funds and history.

findings.risk: Cancel/dispute/resolve DTO reason/note are IsString only; Revision reason MinLength(3) is not trimmed. Blank/whitespace reasons can satisfy DTO validation although UI asks for real text.
findings.nextStep: Define nonblank trimmed server-side note contract and scoped protected-backend authority before implementation; test on isolated validators/HTTP, never mutate real orders to probe.

findings.risk: isCancellable has zero production call sites in the scanned 164 TS files. Its seven-state mismatch is latent helper/documentation drift, not evidence of an exposed cancellation bypass.
findings.nextStep: Preserve workflow restrictions; reconcile helper/docs only with reviewed scope, and keep complete per-command and concurrency acceptance open.

findings.risk: Characterization: DTO accepts assign_direct but triage has no such case and falls back to pending_quote. A missing auto_quote price is checked only after pending_triage->triaging; zero auto_quote differs from manual quote minimum. No payment bypass was created or exercised.
findings.nextStep: DEC02/16 target triage actions and atomicity; fail clearly for unsupported intent and validate before mutation in a scoped protected implementation, without assignment before verified payment.

findings.risk: Characterization of exact verifyAndSettleInTransaction with fake tx/gateway: a previously initiated verified payment can create Ledger/held escrow while order is cancelled/closed, with no paid transition/invoice. This is late-payment reconciliation risk, not proof of real funds lost or a live provider exploit.
findings.nextStep: Define late-payment quarantine/reconciliation and truthful notification contract before production/live gateway; preserve evidence of externally verified money, no silent drop or unauthorized automatic refund. Financial implementation needs scoped authority and isolated race/replay tests.

findings.risk: PaymentsService inserts pending_payment->paid status/history directly with its own CAS rather than OrderWorkflowService. Existing safeguards are present; source-wide central-transition claim is not literally true. approveMilestone also has no order-status precheck in its method; dispute/terminal freeze behavior still needs acceptance.
findings.nextStep: Review all financial command boundaries, status freeze and shared-validator equivalence. Do not change money or rewrite historic ledger merely to unify code paths.

findings.risk: Auto-confirm job uses orders.confirm with customerId; exact in-memory job + confirm methods produce source customer/userId and customer-role escrow decision for an unattended action. Final close is system/null. Financial attribution provenance differs from autonomous system history; no real settlement executed.
findings.nextStep: Before changing protected confirmation/settlement contracts, approve scoped system actor/history policy preserving cutoff/dispute/replay/ledger invariants and human confirmation behavior. Add real DB race/rollback acceptance.

findings.risk: QcService.decide rejects reviewer equal to first active executor only (findFirst). Method characterization permits a reviewer distinct from that returned row; multi-assignment independence is not checked. This is not proof of current HTTP privilege exploit or a second active assignment existing.
findings.nextStep: Require all active execution participants and reviewer capabilities to be checked before multi-executor acceptance; scoped authorization work plus real role/ownership/race tests, no fifth role.

findings.risk: deliverMilestone checks active assignment, paid and pending milestone but does not read parent order status, acceptedAt, checklist or safe output/QC. Exact method with fake closed/disputed parent still marks delivery/message/outbox; no financial dependency invoked. Coupling to approval/release is separately open in GAP06.
findings.nextStep: Specify terminal/dispute freeze and milestone delivery/QC criteria without discarding existing capability. Protected implementation requires precise scoped authorization and DB concurrency/finance tests.

findings.risk: JobRunner.run outer catch maps any downstream Prisma P2002 to already_run after a failed record, logging failed and skipped metrics. Exact in-memory method reproduces this, whereas duplicate initial claim correctly skips work. Keys are interval buckets, not cross-bucket execution leases. Manual job run lacks requested actor/note; automatic HR status change needs governance review.
findings.nextStep: Separate claim conflict handling from execution errors under scoped authorization; define per-job lock/retry/provenance and HR policy. Preserve job registry and retention protections; accept crash, parallel bucket and error metrics with isolated DB, not live job commands.
